description: Record a tool the user explicitly picked/rejected/tried/starred, or PURCHASED. Call it with action 'purchased' right after the user tells you they bought a paid plan of a listed tool (ask first; never log silently), and again later with action 'feedback' once they have used it for a while (e.g. weekly), passing rating and what worked / fell short. Optional fields apply to purchased/feedback only. Stored anonymously under the key; forget_me deletes it. picked/rejected also shape whats_new.

combo.description: Ids of other tools used together with this one

fell_short.description: What fell short (short, no personal data)

price_usd.description: Price paid per period in USD

worked.description: What worked well (short, no personal data)

name: log_choice
title: Log a choice or purchase
